fact: The Ethiopian Standards Board officially approved 5 mandatory cybersecurity standards and 31 guidelines and frameworks, drafted by INSA with the Ethiopian Standards Institute, according to INSA.
ISO states the Institute of Ethiopian Standards is the national standards body, renamed by Proclamation 1263/2021.
The Institute of Ethiopian Standards, one of four entities formed from the former Ethiopian Quality and Standard Authority, oversees a database of over 11,000 standards and 395 mandatory products.
